name: draftmeld
description: Open-source fantasy football draft command center.

scripts.check: npm --prefix frontend run check && node scripts/go-format.mjs --check && cd backend && go vet ./... && go vet ../scripts/zip-directory.go
scripts.format: npm --prefix frontend run format && node scripts/go-format.mjs
scripts.format:check: npm --prefix frontend run format:check && node scripts/go-format.mjs --check
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.test:backend: cd backend && go test ./... && go test ../scripts/zip-directory.go ../scripts/zip-directory_test.go
scripts.verify: npm run version:check && npm run audit && npm run check && npm test && npm run build
